title: Pull request policy
description: Policy file .config/pr-policy.toml, schema 1. Every key is optional except schema. Unknown keys are errors.

argv.description: Command as an argument array. No shell runs it.

pattern.description: Regular expression, JavaScript flavour. Empty means not set.

protected.description: Glob list of branches. The DCO fix and every push are refused on them.

name_pattern.description: Regular expression for new branch names (used by pr-create).

bases.description: Extra allowed base branches (globs). The default branch is always allowed.

required.description: Check names that must pass on the head. Union with the ruleset's required checks. Never removes one.

flaky.description: A failure of these checks is check_flaky (re-run), not check_failed.

flaky_reruns.description: Attempts beyond this number turn a flaky failure into check_failed.

accept_skipped.description: Required checks for which skipped or neutral counts as a pass.

base_sensitive.description: A failure of these checks while the branch is behind the base is check_stale_base (merge the base, no code change).

cancellation_is_load.description: A cancelled required check with no failure is check_cancelled (re-trigger).

watched_workflows.description: Workflow names whose unfinished runs on the head make the verdict WAITING.

source.description: Where the review verdict comes from.

reviewers.description: Logins whose verdict counts. Empty means writers (OWNER, MEMBER, COLLABORATOR) except the PR author.

count_author.description: true: the PR author's reviews count too, even when the author is a writer or is listed in reviewers. Fits processes that post agent reviews under the owner's account. false: the author's reviews never count.

approve_pattern.description: comment-verdict: regular expression for an approval. Required for comment-verdict.

changes_pattern.description: comment-verdict: regular expression for a changes-needed verdict. Required for comment-verdict.

blocking_pattern.description: An approving review that also matches this is not an approval.

flags.description: Regular expression flags for the review and thread patterns.

carry_over.description: none, or clean-base-merge: an approval on an earlier head carries across empty commits and clean merges of the base (comment-verdict only).

max_carry_merges.description: Most merges of the base that one approval may carry across.

rerequest.description: How pr-refresh asks for a new review.

comment.description: Comment text that asks for a new review. Empty means no comment.

reviewers.description: Logins to request a review from.

bots.description: Review bot logins. Their threads block like any other thread.

fix_pattern.description: A thread whose first comment matches this must be fixed (P1). Compiled with review.flags. Empty means no thread must be fixed by rule.

defer_reply.description: Reply text for a deferred thread. A thread whose last comment is a human's open question is never resolved.
defer_reply.default: Deferred under the repository's review policy: not blocking for this change.

required.description: Every non-exempt commit needs a Signed-off-by trailer.

bot_authors.description: Bot logins (for example dependency bots) whose branches the DCO fix may touch.

bot_commits.description: exempt: the repository DCO check exempts bot commits. rewrite: add the trailer to them.

fix.description: rewrite-trailers: the DCO-only force-push exception. report: only report.

dequeue_for_fix.description: May the DCO fix dequeue a queued PR first.

method.description: Merge method. The ruleset must allow it.

queue.description: auto: use the merge queue when the ruleset has one. required: refuse to merge without one. never: never enqueue.

jump.description: never: no queue jump. labelled: jump when the PR has a label from jump_labels.

jump_labels.description: Labels that allow a queue jump.

delete_branch.description: own-only: delete only a branch that this run created. never: delete no branch.

high_risk_paths.description: Globs of paths that need the user's confirmation before pr-merge lands a change. A rename counts when the old or the new path matches. An empty list turns the check off.

watch_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between the polls of pr-merge watch. The flag --interval overrides it.

ready_when.description: When a draft becomes ready for review.

pr_ci.description: always: full CI on every PR push. label: full CI only when a label is present.

run_once.description: Label that starts one full CI run.

run_always.description: Label that starts full CI on every push.

congestion_queue_length.description: Queue length at or above which CI counts as congested.

max_refreshes.description: Refresh pushes per fleet pass when CI is not congested.

max_refreshes_congested.description: Refresh pushes per fleet pass when CI is congested.

link.description: closes-when-complete: Closes #n when every Done-when box is provable before merge, else Part of #n.

done_when_heading.description: Heading of the checklist section in a linked issue.

done_when.description: block: unchecked boxes block the merge. warn: they only warn. off: ignore them.

sections.description: Required body sections. A PR template, when present, wins.

template.description: Path of the PR template in the repository.

footer.description: Attribution footer appended verbatim to the body.

enforce.description: true: a body that misses a section is a body_template blocker.

prepush.description: Steps that run in order before every push.

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the repository root.

when_changed.description: Run only when a changed file (against the merge base) matches one of these globs. Empty means always.

regenerate.description: Generated outputs that a base merge regenerates, never hand-merges.

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the repository root.

when_changed.description: Regenerate when a changed input matches one of these globs. Empty means on every conflict in outputs.

outputs.description: Globs of generated files. A conflict limited to these paths is resolved by regenerating.

inventories.description: Lists that must name every added file.

added.description: Globs of added files that the inventory must name.

exclude.description: Globs of added files that the inventory ignores.

group_depth.description: Enforce only for groups (the first N path segments) that the inventory already lists.

update.description: Optional argument array that rewrites the inventory. Empty means none.

gates.description: Extra merge gates that the repository declares.

value.description: The label name or the check name.

freeze.description: true (or PR_FLEET_FREEZE=1): the fleet plans nothing that pushes or enqueues.

hold.description: Pull request numbers that the fleet must not touch.

max_merges_per_pass.description: Merges or enqueues that one fleet pass may start. Unset: 3 through a merge queue, 1 for direct merges. The pass also keeps the queue length plus its enqueues at or below ci.congestion_queue_length.

max_merges_per_pass_congested.description: Merges or enqueues that one fleet pass may start when the queue length is at or above ci.congestion_queue_length.
